placement_after: The boarding announcement came while Heather was gathering their bags. Buddy stood, revealing the napkin. Neet scooped it into his little bag and strutted toward the gate before Heather saw it.
alt_text: Buddy stands up to board, revealing the olive napkin that Neet must retrieve.
scene_brief: Istanbul airport lounge at boarding announcement. Buddy has just STOOD UP on the broad upholstered recliner seat, all four substantial paws visibly supported on TOP cushion, continuous elongated torso/head/neck. His lifting body reveals a WHITE NAPKIN BUNDLE of green/black olives lying ON TOP of seat cushion exactly where his belly had rested. Neet stands on floor at front edge, full four-paw body visible and nose lifted toward the newly exposed napkin, furtive look, preparing to retrieve it. Seat low enough for Neet's muzzle reach. Olives must be clearly ABOVE cushion, never under seat or between upholstery. Airport windows with aircraft outside only, no mosque skyline invented. No human faces or towel costume. Comedy sleepy accomplice reveals stolen stash. Short smooth coats, tiny Neet nub, Buddy low slender tail.
